facts.summary: Initial Phase 1 data showed modest responses, only few confirmed partial responses · Phase 1 · BDTX-189 in EGFR/HER2-altered solid tumors · not yet approved
facts.indication: Advanced solid tumors harboring EGFR or HER2 alterations

evidence.summary: Preliminary anti-cancer activity observed in heavily pre-treated patients (prior EGFR/HER2-directed and/or I/O agents) in a variety of tumor types and genomic alterations in EGFR or HER2, including confirmed partial responses
evidence.safety: BDTX-189 demonstrated a favorable tolerability profile, with no dose-limiting toxicities at doses of ≤800 mg QD fasting and non-fasting in the dose-escalation cohorts.
